test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment without changing its meaning in the given sentence.

He gave his**__ heart and soul__** to make the entire show a success.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. 'entire energy and effort'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"offer of peace and harmony"** means an attempt to establish peaceful and friendly relations. (शांति और सद्भाव की पेशकश) • **Example:** The treaty was an offer of peace and harmony between the two nations. • The word **"practical experience"** refers to knowledge or skill obtained by doing things rather than by studying or observing. (व्यावहारिक अनुभव) • **Example:** She has years of practical experience in the field of medicine. • The word **"partially useful knowledge"** means knowledge that is not completely useful or is only useful in certain situations. (आंशिक रूप से उपयोगी ज्ञान) • **Example:** The training provided partially useful knowledge that only helped in some aspects of the job. • The word **"entire energy and effort"** means putting all one's physical and mental strength into something. (पूरा ऊर्जा और प्रयास) • **Example:** He put his entire energy and effort into preparing for the marathon. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. 'entire energy and effort'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Offer of peace and harmony** (शांति और सद्भाव की पेशकश): An attempt to create friendly and peaceful relations. • **Example:** The new government extended an offer of peace and harmony to the neighboring country. • **Practical experience** (व्यावहारिक अनुभव): Knowledge or skill gained through direct involvement in a task. • **Example:** Practical experience is often more valuable than theoretical knowledge. • **Partially useful knowledge** (आंशिक रूप से उपयोगी ज्ञान): Information that is only somewhat helpful or relevant. • **Example:** The course provided partially useful knowledge, covering only basic aspects of the subject. 50:Tb1b, ```html The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Celestial**.
